label: contested
acceptance_criterion: Acceptable: identifies as decisive whether the remark denies the group's members equal worth as human beings (BGE 131 IV 23 E. 3) and explains that this depends on its exact wording and context, which the facts leave open; a reasoned leaning is acceptable, and so is an acquittal reasoned on the wording not being established (in dubio pro reo, Art. 10 Abs. 3 StPO). rejected: Sì. Una barzelletta volgare su una comunità religiosa è chiaramente punibile secondo l'art. 261bis CP.
